seoTitle: How to Renew a Hostinger Domain and Its Pricing
metaDescription: Learn how to check your Hostinger domain expiry, renew active or expired domains, and understand renewal pricing, grace periods, and redemption fees.
intro: Missing a domain renewal date can put your entire online presence at risk, so knowing how Hostinger handles renewals ahead of time is worth the few minutes it takes. This guide explains how to check your expiry date, renew before or after expiration, and understand what grace periods and redemption fees mean for your wallet.

steps.heading: Check your domain's expiry date
steps.body: Log into your Hostinger dashboard and locate your domain's current status to see exactly how much time you have left before it lapses.

steps.heading: Renew an active domain
steps.body: If your domain hasn't expired yet, renew it directly from the dashboard to extend registration and avoid any interruption.

steps.heading: Understand grace periods and redemption fees
steps.body: If a domain has already expired, learn how the grace period works and what additional redemption fees may apply to get it back.

steps.heading: Apply available renewal discounts
steps.body: Check for any renewal discounts or coupons before completing payment, since these can reduce the cost of extending your domain.

faq.question: What happens if my Hostinger domain expires?
faq.answer: It usually enters a grace period during which you can still renew it, though redemption fees may apply the longer it stays expired.

faq.question: Can I renew a domain before it expires?
faq.answer: Yes, renewing an active domain early is straightforward and helps you avoid any service interruption.

faq.question: Are there discounts available for domain renewal?
faq.answer: Hostinger sometimes offers renewal discounts, so it's worth checking for available coupons before you pay.

faq.question: How do I avoid losing my domain name?
faq.answer: Renewing before expiry or acting quickly during the grace period is the best way to secure your online identity.
